_comment: Tier 1 — human-approved answers served verbatim with no model generation (FR-10, FR-11). At maturity this tier is expected to carry 50–70% of traffic (section 10.2). Tier 2 answers that recur and receive positive feedback are promoted here after human review; that promotion is a steward action, not an automatic one.
_conversationalNote: Entries with matchMode 'whole' handle conversational input — greetings, thanks, farewells. These are NOT a relaxation of the refusal policy or the retrieval floor: a greeting is not a factual question, so answering it cites nothing and risks nothing. Without them a citizen who opens with 'hello' — which is how most people open a chat — receives a refusal as their first experience of the service, and does not come back. 'whole' matching is essential here: as a loose phrase, 'hello' would swallow 'hello, how do I renew my licence?'.

match: អរុណសួស្តី
ទិវាសួស្តី
សាយ័ណ្ហសួស្តី

answer.en:
Hello. SuperAsk answers questions about Cambodian government services — the steps, the documents you need, the official fee, and which office handles it. Every answer shows the official source it came from.

You can ask things like:
• How do I renew my driving licence?
• What documents do I need for a birth certificate?
• My child's birth was never registered. What now?

What would you like to know?

answer.en:
You are welcome. Ask another question any time.

Remember to confirm anything important with the responsible office before you act on it — SuperAsk gives information, not a binding decision.

អ្នកអាចជួយអ្វីបាន

answer.en:
SuperAsk answers questions about Cambodian government services. It gives you procedures, required documents, official fees, timelines, and which office handles your case, and it shows the official source behind every answer.

It does not handle individual cases, look up personal records, or give legal advice. For those, it will connect you to an officer.

match: ក្រសួងណាខ្លះ

answer.en:
In this prototype, SuperAsk covers two sample service domains:

1. Ministry of Public Works and Transport — driving licences: first issue, renewal, categories, replacement, foreign licence conversion, fees, and office hours.
2. Ministry of Interior — civil registration: birth registration, late registration, births abroad, corrections, death registration, the family book, and fees.

All content in this prototype is sample content and is not authoritative. Additional ministries join as the platform onboards them.
